notes:
Orbit 0.2.2

Inbox: swipe a held message left to dismiss it, or hold one to start picking and clear several with the bin. Either way you get a few seconds to undo, which nothing else offers once a message is dismissed.

Settings: import a CSV Orbit exported, so a new phone starts with your history instead of an empty ledger. Anything already here is recognised and skipped, so importing the same file twice changes nothing.
